geometry_source: Complete evaluated Blender mesh; no depth backprojection or train-cloud upsampling
color_method: bilinear sRGB from highest abs(n dot ray)/camera-Z^2 training observation; all four interpolation pixels must be valid opaque geometry; exact mesh ray visibility within1mm
fallback: sRGB-encoded constant material base color for unobserved/transparent surfaces; linked textures and lighting are not baked there
opacity_limitation: near-unit isotropic Gaussians do not reproduce physical glass transmission or view-dependent highlights
